anchor.semantic_hook: A two-way street becomes a real road with two opposing lanes, and every exchange travels in both directions.
anchor.setting: A long indoor civic concourse is paved as a two-direction road linking an ordinary lounge, company floor, crossing, home dining nook, classroom, and business table. At its center, one impossible strip of roadway curls vertically into a complete loop while its two lanes still carry objects in opposite directions. The surrounding furniture and props remain ordinary and undecorated.
